headline: ServiceNow stock slides as earnings miss offsets expanded enterprise AI deal growth
summary: ServiceNow shares fell as third-quarter earnings missed analyst expectations. The slide occurred despite an increase in multi-million-dollar AI contracts and a raised outlook for artificial intelligence products.
why: ServiceNow is a enterprise cloud platform vendor; its earnings reflect corporate digital transformation and IT software spending trends.

impacts.name: ServiceNow, Inc.
impacts.why: Quarterly earnings missing analyst estimates triggered selling among software investors.

why_moved: An earnings miss overshadowed growth in AI deal bookings and an upgraded outlook.
